response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, hands-on senior engineer with ~15+ years of experience, a CS degree, and solid distributed-systems exposure (high-throughput low-latency services at Dunnhumby). However, the resume shows no experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core of this role — and no evidence of principal-level, multi-workstream leadership across teams at enterprise scale. The profile reads as strong senior/staff full-stack rather than IC6 experimentation-systems architect.
strengths: Broad polyglot engineering experience (TypeScript, Node.js, D, C/C++, Java) across web, backend, and embedded
High-scale production experience: micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby
Strong engineering fundamentals and mentorship record (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source tooling)
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience
No demonstrated data/statistical analysis or telemetry-infrastructure work required for the role
Career trajectory is senior/staff at small-to-mid companies; lacks evidence of principal-level cross-org architectural leadership

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
